run_make_right: run the script to mirror a left SHARPA hand MJCF into a right-handed version via Y-plane reflection
preprocess_meshes: preprocess meshes by Y-mirroring every .stl and .obj file from a source directory into a destination directory
build_mirrored_spec: build a mirrored MuJoCo MjSpec from a left-hand XML with renamed mesh references and mirrored body tree
rewrite_left_to_right: rewrite all left_ identifiers to right_ in an MJCF XML string including body, joint, geom, and model names
mirror_body: mirror a MuJoCo body and its children through the Y=0 plane updating positions, quaternions, joints, geoms, and sites
